title: Interview Intelligence AI
summary: Turns a resume and a job description into an interview report with evidence-grounded answers, ranked skill gaps and a prep plan.
bullets: Developed a full-stack app that turns a resume and job description into an interview report (evidence-grounded answers, skill gaps by severity, prep plan), with Gemini output constrained by a Zod JSON schema.
Secured the API with JWT authentication, a token blacklist for logout, rate limiting and per-user report isolation.
Exported ATS-style resume Markdown to PDF through headless Chrome (Puppeteer) in a Docker image; deployed the frontend on Vercel and the backend on Render.
limitations: No automated check of how good or correct the AI answers are yet.
Tests are limited to two backend smoke tests.

title: Messy Mashup Genre Classification
summary: Classifies 10 music genres from noisy 30-second mashups; final leaderboard Macro F1 0.954.
bullets: Closed a train/test distribution gap by synthesizing 10,000 noisy training clips from 1,000 clean stems with ESC-50 background noise, validated with 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold grouped by song to prevent leakage.

Raised validation Macro F1 from ~0.45-0.49 (MFCC, Random Forest/Gradient Boosting) to ~0.92 (ResNet-50) and ~0.96 (Audio Spectrogram Transformer) by fine-tuning pretrained models on log-mel spectrograms.
Combined AST and ResNet-50 in a 60/40 weighted ensemble with test-time augmentation, reaching a final leaderboard Macro F1 of 0.954.
limitations: Competition data is private and not included in the repo.

title: LLM Code Deployment Agent
context: IITM Tools in Data Science project
summary: Turns a natural-language brief into a static web app with an LLM, then creates or updates a GitHub repository and enables GitHub Pages.
bullets: Created a FastAPI service that turns a natural-language brief into a static web app using an LLM (OpenAI-compatible API), then creates or updates a GitHub repository and enables GitHub Pages.
Verified each deployment by polling the live URL, ran generation as background tasks, validated requests with Pydantic, and supported revision requests on existing repositories.
limitations: Generation runs as in-process background tasks (no external job queue).
No automated tests in the repo yet.

title: MedSyncPro Hospital Management System
summary: Role-based appointment system (admin, doctor, patient) with server-side double-booking checks and scheduled jobs.
bullets: Implemented a role-based (admin, doctor, patient) appointment system with JWT authentication and server-side double-booking checks.
Scheduled Celery Beat jobs on Redis: daily 08:00 appointment reminders and a monthly report.

title: Comment Category Prediction
summary: Multi-class comment classification; compared 8 models on TF-IDF features, best Macro F1 0.8295 from a voting ensemble.
bullets: Compared 8 models on TF-IDF features; a voting ensemble of SGD, bagged Logistic Regression and SVC reached Macro F1 0.8295, ahead of LightGBM (0.7386) and an MLP (0.7460).

results.model: Voting ensemble (SGD + bagged Logistic Regression + SVC)
